claims.claim_text_verbatim: We introduce SFT-as-context, a training-free method in which the parent model uses the SFT model’s response as context to answer the query.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context is a training-free method using SFT responses as context for the parent model

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This allows the parent model to acquire fine-tuned capabilities from the SFT response through in-context learning while preserving its own general capabilities.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context enables acquiring fine-tuned capabilities via context while maintaining general capabilities

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Across 19 parent-SFT model pairs and 11 benchmarks, SFT-as-context remains close to the SFT models on fine-tuned capabilities, with gaps of only 2.2 and 2.1 percentage points on AIME 2024 and LiveCodeBench and 2.0 macro MAE on NutriBench-English, while staying within 2.2 percentage points of the parent models on general capabilities on average.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context performs closely to SFT models on fine-tuned benchmarks and parents on general benchmarks

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Remarkably, it can solve queries requiring both fine-tuned and general capabilities, even when neither the parent nor SFT model succeeds alone.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context solves combined capability queries where neither parent nor SFT model succeeds individually

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This approach also extends beyond parent-SFT pairs: responses from a small open-source SFT model can improve a strong closed-source LLM, outperforming either model alone.
claims.claim_summary: Open-source SFT model responses enhance closed-source LLMs beyond parent-SFT model pairs

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Furthermore, we use a Bayesian framework to derive theoretical guarantees that bound the error of SFT-as-context relative to the SFT model on fine-tuned capabilities and to the parent model on general capabilities.
claims.claim_summary: Theoretical Bayesian guarantees bound SFT-as-context error relative to both SFT and parent models

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In addition, we visualize the attention weights and find that the parent model attends more to useful SFT responses and less to irrelevant ones, suggesting that selective attention helps the parent model use the SFT response through in-context learning.
claims.claim_summary: Attention visualization reveals parent models selectively attend to relevant SFT responses

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Instead, we propose a training-free method, SFT-as-context, which leverages the in-context learning capability of language models by providing a fine-tuned model’s response as context to its parent model and prompting the parent model to generate the final answer.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context leverages parent model in-context learning using SFT responses as prompt context

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Despite its simplicity, SFT-as-context preserves fine-tuning gains while mitigating forgetting across all 19 evaluated parent-fine-tuned model pairs and 11 benchmarks, spanning mathematical reasoning, coding, nutrition estimation, and general capabilities.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context mitigates forgetting while retaining fine-tuning gains across 19 model pairs

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Using SFT checkpoints collected from Hugging Face, SFT-as-context achieves 95.0% and 94.1% recovery rates of the fine-tuning gains on AIME 2024 and LiveCodeBench (Jain et al., 2025), respectively.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context achieves 95.0% and 94.1% recovery of fine-tuning gains on AIME 2024 and LiveCodeBench

claims.claim_text_verbatim: At the same time, it achieves an average recovery rate of 94.2% for general capabilities across instruction-following, multilingual tasks, question answering, and planning.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context recovers 94.2% of general capabilities across multiple domain benchmarks

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Additionally, SFT-as-context combines fine-tuned and general capabilities within the same response, going beyond what either model can achieve alone.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context combines specialized and general capabilities into a single output

claims.claim_text_verbatim: For example, on NutriBench-Non-English (Dhaliwal et al., 2025), as shown in Figure 1(c), SFT-as-context achieves recovery rates of 84.6% for nutrition estimation and 95.2% for language consistency.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context recovers 84.6% nutrition estimation and 95.2% language consistency on NutriBench

claims.claim_text_verbatim: More importantly, SFT-as-context requires only standard text input-output interfaces, making it applicable to closed-source models without access to their parameters.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context works with text interfaces and applies to closed-source models without weight access

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This flexibility allows responses from a small open-source SFT model to serve as context for a stronger closed-source model, even when the latter is not the parent of the SFT model.
claims.claim_summary: Responses from small SFT models can guide non-parent closed-source models as context

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Notably, this holds for a strong proprietary model: providing responses from a fine-tuned Qwen3-4B as context to Gemini 3.5 Flash reduces macro MAE from 17.44 to 14.08 on NutriBench-English, outperforming either model alone.
claims.claim_summary: Providing Qwen3-4B responses as context to Gemini 3.5 Flash reduces NutriBench MAE to 14.08

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We find that the parent model selectively attends to the SFT output based on its effectiveness.
claims.claim_summary: Parent models vary attention to SFT outputs based on their effectiveness

claims.claim_text_verbatim: For example, as shown in Figure 1(d), the parent model allocates substantially more attention to the SFT response for nutrition queries than for unrelated queries (37.44% versus 15.11%).
claims.claim_summary: Parent models allocate 37.44% attention to relevant SFT context versus 15.11% for unrelated queries

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Crucially, SFT-as-context is a novel, training-free approach to mitigating forgetting that requires neither access to model weights nor the fine-tuning process.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context mitigates forgetting without needing training, model weights, or fine-tuning process access

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Across 19 parent-fine-tuned model pairs and 11 benchmarks, SFT-as-context preserves 92.0% of the fine-tuning gains on average, while recovering 94.2% of the general-capability performance gap between parent and SFT models.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context retains 92.0% fine-tuning gains while recovering 94.2% of the general capability gap

claims.claim_text_verbatim: SFT-as-context brings this performance back to near the parent model’s level, with a gap of only 0.8 percentage points, while preserving most of the gains on LiveCodeBench (39.8 out of 41.8 percentage points).
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context closes CoQA loss to 0.8 points while preserving 39.8 point LiveCodeBench gain

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Figure 1(d) shows that the parent model attends more to useful SFT responses than hallucinated ones, with a 22.33 percentage point difference in the average share of attention allocated to the SFT responses.
claims.claim_summary: Parent models attend 22.33 percentage points more to useful SFT context than hallucinated context

claims.claim_text_verbatim: As shown in Table 2, using responses from open-source SFT models as context consistently improves the performance of a strong proprietary model on NutriBench-English, achieving lower MAE than either model alone.
claims.claim_summary: Open-source SFT context consistently lowers NutriBench MAE for proprietary models beyond standalone baseline

claims.claim_text_verbatim: These results suggest that the gains of SFT-as-context cannot be explained solely by the SFT-as-context instructions or an additional inference pass.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context improvements stem from context content rather than prompt instructions or additional passes

claims.claim_text_verbatim: As shown in Tables 7 and 8, SFT-as-context outperforms even the oracle router.
claims.claim_summary: SFT-as-context surpasses oracle routing in joint capability success rates

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Specifically, the ratio of second-pass to first-pass response tokens is at most 13.0%.
claims.claim_summary: Second-pass generation adds at most 13.0% token overhead for math and coding models

claims.claim_text_verbatim: When a query requires both fine-tuned nutrition estimation capability and general multilingual capability, only SFT-as-context satisfies both requirements.
claims.claim_summary: When a query requires both fine-tuned nutrition estimation capability and general multilingual capability, only SFT-as-context satisfies both requirements.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Subfigure (d) shows that the parent model attends more to useful English SFT responses than to hallucinated SFT responses to non-food queries, suggesting that selective attention helps the parent model use the SFT response through in-context learning.
claims.claim_summary: Subfigure (d) shows that the parent model attends more to useful English SFT responses than to hallucinated SFT responses to non-food queries, suggesting that selective attention helps the parent model use the SFT response through in-context learning.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: First, we use a Bayesian framework for in-context learning (Xie et al., 2022; Hu et al., 2024) to provide theoretical guarantees that bound the differences in error between parent models, SFT models, and SFT-as-context.
claims.claim_summary: First, we use a Bayesian framework for in-context learning (Xie et al., 2022; Hu et al., 2024) to provide theoretical guarantees that bound the differences in error between parent models, SFT models, and SFT-as-context.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Table 1: SFT-as-context successfully mitigates the forgetting of general capabilities and maintains high fine-tuned capabilities compared to SFT across all benchmarks.
claims.claim_summary: Table 1: SFT-as-context successfully mitigates the forgetting of general capabilities and maintains high fine-tuned capabilities compared to SFT across all benchmarks.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Consistent with prior observations of forgetting after SFT (Chen et al., 2026; Huan et al., 2026), we find that the improvement of fine-tuned capabilities comes at the expense of general capabilities.
claims.claim_summary: Consistent with prior observations of forgetting after SFT (Chen et al., 2026; Huan et al., 2026), we find that the improvement of fine-tuned capabilities comes at the expense of general capabilities.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: As shown in Table 1, SFT causes substantial forgetting of general capabilities, reducing general capability scores by 33.2 percentage points on average.
claims.claim_summary: As shown in Table 1, SFT causes substantial forgetting of general capabilities, reducing general capability scores by 33.2 percentage points on average.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: For example, among the three nutrition SFT models, Qwen3-8B shows the largest drop in acknowledging non-food queries, from 99.6% to 10.7%, catastrophically forgetting the instruction-following capability of its parent model.
claims.claim_summary: For example, among the three nutrition SFT models, Qwen3-8B shows the largest drop in acknowledging non-food queries, from 99.6% to 10.7%, catastrophically forgetting the instruction-following capability of its parent model.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The SFT model significantly improves math correctness, from 40.6% to 65.0%, but fails to follow the format constraints.
claims.claim_summary: The SFT model significantly improves math correctness, from 40.6% to 65.0%, but fails to follow the format constraints.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Taken together, fine-tuning substantially improves performance on the task the model is fine-tuned on, but at the expense of forgetting general capabilities that the parent model already possesses, e.g., instruction-following and multilingual understanding.
claims.claim_summary: Taken together, fine-tuning substantially improves performance on the task the model is fine-tuned on, but at the expense of forgetting general capabilities that the parent model already possesses, e.g., instruction-following and multilingual understanding.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Despite its simplicity, SFT-as-context achieves performance close to the parent model on general capabilities while remaining close to the SFT model on fine-tuned capabilities, effectively combining the strengths of SFT and parent models, as shown in Table 1.
claims.claim_summary: Despite its simplicity, SFT-as-context achieves performance close to the parent model on general capabilities while remaining close to the SFT model on fine-tuned capabilities, effectively combining the strengths of SFT and parent models, as shown in Table 1.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: For OCR-Nemotron-1.1-14B, SFT reduces CoQA performance by 73.4 percentage points relative to the parent model, indicating severe forgetting in conversational question answering.
claims.claim_summary: For OCR-Nemotron-1.1-14B, SFT reduces CoQA performance by 73.4 percentage points relative to the parent model, indicating severe forgetting in conversational question answering.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This highlights that SFT-as-context can mitigate severe forgetting while preserving substantial fine-tuning gains.
claims.claim_summary: This highlights that SFT-as-context can mitigate severe forgetting while preserving substantial fine-tuning gains.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This is effectively mitigated by a larger parent: the 32B parent exhibits this failure far less often, yielding a smaller remaining gap for the 32B models than for the 7B ones (an average gap of −1.8 versus −7.5).
claims.claim_summary: This is effectively mitigated by a larger parent: the 32B parent exhibits this failure far less often, yielding a smaller remaining gap for the 32B models than for the 7B ones (an average gap of −1.8 versus −7.5).

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The theorem identifies sufficient conditions under which SFT-as-context improves in-domain per- formance compared to the parent model while limiting degradation compared to the SFT model.
claims.claim_summary: The theorem identifies sufficient conditions under which SFT-as-context improves in-domain per- formance compared to the parent model while limiting degradation compared to the SFT model.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This selective attention suggests that the parent model can use useful information from SFT responses through in-context learning while limiting the influence of irrelevant context, providing a possible explanation for how SFT-as-context mitigates forgetting while preserving fine-tuned capabilities.
